title: Cloud bank billows

source.source_title: Top Of The Cloud - Time Lapse (Wide Screen 16:9)
source.why_this_clip: A wide white cumulus cloud fills the lower half of the frame against blue sky, and its top edge billows as lobes swell and shift in time-lapse. The clip has no cuts; this interval has the strongest change in the cloud's outline, with a lobe rising on the left and the right side lifting.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected16raw source samples spanning the retained interval and boundary margins in preflight-source.jpg. One continuous event; no internal cut/dissolve observed.

assembly_summary: A cropped bank of cloud keeps the original four angular strokes while its three lobe heights follow the observed time-lapse. The bottom boundary stays below the frame rather than inventing a floating closed cloud.
review_note: Native identity passes; sampled source pose fails. The right cloud lobe does not travel far enough toward the frame edge. By the final sample the source’s highest right lobe is at the far right and the contour rises toward that edge, while the drawing peaks much farther left and slopes downward through a long right-hand section. Normal-speed motion remains unapproved; classifier unrun. No training ran.
